title: Voyager 40th Anniversary at Air and Space Museum
description: Ed Stone, Voyager project scientist, speaks at an event to celebrate the 40th Anniversary of the launch of the Voyager 1 and 2 missions, Tuesday, September 5, 2017 at Smithsonian's National Air and Space Museum in Washington. Voyager 1 was launched September 5, 1977, with a mission to study Jupiter
keywords: Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum (NASM)
